shillibeer-london-omnibus.description: A large dark-lacquered horse-drawn coach with a luggage roof and lit lanterns stands on wet cobbles in fog at dusk. Two dark horses are harnessed at the front. Passengers in top hats and bonnets sit inside its windows, and a few more stand at the open rear door. A conductor in a long coat and top hat points at the door, and a woman in a shawl and bonnet waits on the step. Old-style buildings, gas lamps and another carriage fill the background.

new-york-harlem-horsecar.description: A single dark horse pulls a wooden streetcar with arched windows along cobbled tram rails, with a driver on the front bench and well-dressed passengers in top hats and bonnets inside. Brick buildings with awnings and warm gas-style lanterns line the street, and people in long coats and dresses stand on the pavement. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

san-francisco-clay-street-cable-car.description: A wooden open cable car with a man in a dark suit and cap working a grip lever on its platform, descending a steep cobbled street between rails. Victorian wooden houses with bay windows line the street, gas-style lamps stand at the kerb, and people in long coats and hats watch from the sidewalk. A grey bay and hills are visible at the far end of the street under a cloudy sky. No visible text, frame or border.

richmond-electric-streetcar-network.description: An electric streetcar with a trolley pole raised to an overhead wire, varnished wood body with a glowing headlamp, rolls down a cobbled brick street. Crowds of men in bowler and top hats and women in long dresses and straw hats line both sides and watch; a few are gesturing. Horse-drawn carriages and brick and frame buildings recede in the background, with smoke or mist drifting through the scene. A small illegible scrawl, likely the painter's signature, sits in the lower right corner. The painting fills the whole image edge to edge with no frame.

city-south-london-deep-tube.description: An oil painting of a dark circular iron-ringed tunnel. A small boxy riveted black locomotive with a cab and a driver in a cap pulls a brown carriage with passengers in bowler hats and shawls. Lanterns hang on the walls, and there are sparks and faint haze at the front. No text, frame or gore.

budapest-metro-opens.description: A dark tiled underground platform with iron pillars and a lamp-lit wooden electric carriage with a rounded roof. Well-dressed people in top hats, bowler hats, long skirts and feathered hats crowd the platform, and a man in a frock coat steps toward the open door. The tunnel is dim, with a shaft of light at the far end. No visible text, frame or border.

paris-metro-opens.description: A green cast-iron canopy with curving plant-like stems and glowing amber glass panels stands over a staircase on a city street. A crowd of men in top hats and bowler hats and women in long bustled dresses moves around and down the steps. Haussmann-style stone buildings and trees line the street under an overcast sky. The painting fills the frame with no visible text, border or signature.

new-york-subway-opens.description: A dense crowd of men in bowler hats and dark coats, and women in long dresses and hats, stands on a platform in a vaulted, brick-and-tile station with skylights overhead and wall lamps glowing. A dark wooden electric railcar with lit windows waits at the right, and a uniformed conductor leans from its door. Painterly, oil-like style, no visible text.

buenos-aires-subte-opens.description: A dim underground station with a glossy wooden tram-like electric carriage at the platform edge, its windows glowing with lamps. Men in bowler hats and dark overcoats and a woman in a wide hat and long coat stand on the platform, a man steps toward the open door. Ornate tiled walls, iron railings, pendant lamps and columns line the tunnel. No visible text, frame or border.

madrid-metro-opens.reason: The posters on the station walls have legible painted lettering (e.g. 'Brea Erdinario', 'Rhoprigno', partial words on the left). Repaint the posters blank or as plain abstract shapes with no letters.
madrid-metro-opens.description: An oil painting of a tiled, vaulted underground station with hanging bulbs. A man in a dark coat gestures toward a green-and-wood electric carriage with uniformed staff, while a crowd in flat caps, bowlers and black mantillas watches. Large advertising posters on the curved walls show painted words and a bottle. The image runs edge to edge.
